_design_note: Neutral texts — no embedded failure signals. Only PSE tags distinguish causal from distractor. Name-trap distractors whose file names partially match the failing test function names.

cases.title: Three unit test failures across workspace — module-path vs function-name ambiguity

candidates.text: Phase transition module. Exports `Transition`, `TransitionGraph`, `TransitionKind`. Defines ordering constraints and graph traversal for cognitive phase steps. Has inline unit test module.
Evaluation run ledger. Exports `EvaluationRunLedger`, `EvaluationRunEntry`, `init_ledger`, `append_to_ledger`. Append-only, hash-chained record of evaluation runs. Has inline unit test module.
Block pool for substrate memory management. Exports `Pool`, `Block`, `PoolConfig`, `dealloc_block`. Manages block lifecycle and concurrent access patterns. Has inline unit test module.
Phase ordering rules. Exports `PhaseOrder`, `OrderConstraint`, `PriorityRule`. Defines precedence relationships between phase kinds used by the scheduler. Has inline unit test module.
candidates._trap: File name 'phase_order' matches test function name 'phase_order_v2'. Not the failing module.

candidates.text: Hash chain utilities shared by ledger and replay subsystems. Exports `HashChain`, `ChainNode`, `chain_extend`. Provides the chaining primitive consumed by append operations. Has inline unit test module.
candidates._trap: File name 'hash_chain' matches test function name 'hash_chain_entry'. Not the failing module.

candidates.text: Concurrent deallocation guard for pool operations. Exports `DeallocGuard`, `DeallocToken`, `DeallocQueue`. Coordinates concurrent block release ordering. Has inline unit test module.
candidates._trap: File name and concept 'dealloc' + 'concurrent' matches test 'dealloc_concurrent'. Not the failing module.

candidates.text: Phase execution engine. Exports `PhaseEngine`, `PhaseStep`, `EngineConfig`. Schedules and executes cognitive phase steps using the transition graph. Has inline unit test module.
Cognitive state machine. Exports `StateMachine`, `StateTransition`, `StateKind`. Manages agent state across phase boundaries defined by transition rules. Has inline unit test module.
Replay verifier for evaluation runs. Exports `verify_trial_replay`, `ReplayObservation`, `ReplayVerificationReport`. Byte-identity check over ledger entries. Has inline unit test module.
Scoring functions over evaluation ledgers. Exports `score_ledger`, `score_capability_profile`, `cognition_uplift`. Aggregates metric observations into capability scores. Has inline unit test module.
Memory allocator for substrate blocks. Exports `Allocator`, `AllocSlot`, `AllocResult`. Provides raw allocation and deallocation primitives consumed by the pool. Has inline unit test module.
Cell substrate layer. Exports `CellSubstrate`, `SubstrateConfig`, `attach_cell`. Top-level substrate abstraction over allocator and pool. Has inline unit test module.
Integration test harness for pse-cognition. Covers cross-module interactions between phase_engine, state_machine, and transition subsystems. No inline unit tests — integration scope only.
Integration test harness for pse-eval-matrix. Covers end-to-end evaluation flows: ledger append, scoring, replay verification. No inline unit tests — integration scope only.
nextest structured test output from most recent CI run. Per-test status, duration, retry count for all 847 test functions across 12 crates.
Workspace manifest. Declares 8 member crates and shared dependency version requirements.

events.message: FAILED ... (2 failures, output truncated — see target/nextest/)
changed Fixed type internal precision in primitives.rs last commit, two metric modules now fail their unit tests
